title: Magnetic field therapy
what: A device creates a weak magnetic field over the sore area. This helps reduce swelling and pain.
why: For joint and back pain, after injuries and fractures, and for swelling, as your doctor prescribes.
duration: a session usually takes 10 to 20 minutes; a course is usually about 10 sessions
tell_doctor: If you have a pacemaker or another implanted device
If you have bleeding problems or take blood thinners

prepare.title: Metal
prepare.text: Remove your watch and jewelry. Keep bank cards and your phone away from the device.

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: Wear something comfortable. It is often done right through clothing or a bandage. Check with the clinic.

steps: The device's coil is placed on or near the sore area
The nurse turns it on and sets the time
You lie still until the signal
The device is removed, and you can go
after: You can return to normal activities right away
Come to sessions on schedule. The full course matters
Sometimes pain gets a little worse in the first days, then eases. Tell your doctor
red_flags: Dizziness, strong weakness, or a jump in blood pressure after the session: tell your doctor

faq.q: Can it be done with a cast?
faq.a: Often yes, right through the cast. Your doctor will decide.
The field is weak and works locally. Your doctor will check for reasons not to use it before prescribing.

reminders.text: Magnetic therapy today. Remove your watch and jewelry, and bring your referral.
